credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Graphite sketch of a landscape. Simple line drawing, no shading. On the right side of the paper, in the foreground, is a large hill formation. On the left side, in the background, there is a smaller hill formation. The horizon visible in the background is level with the top of the smaller hill on the left side of the paper. There are also several small bumps drawn on the hill formations on the right and in the lower center of the composition.
title: Untitled (Palo Duro Canyon)
